info.title: MigrationGuard.Tool
info.description: Global tool (dotnet migration-check) that analyzes a compiled EF Core migrations assembly for production-dangerous operations.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: MigrationGuard — analyze EF Core migrations for production-dangerous operations.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the compiled assembly containing the migrations (e.g. bin/Debug/net8.0/MyApp.dll).

options.name: --context
options.description: Name of the DbContext to analyze (simple name or full name).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to migrationguard.json (provider, largeTables, severity overrides, baseline).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text (default) or sarif. [default: text]

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: Write every discovered migration id to this baseline file and exit (adoption in an existing project).
